domain_title: Architecture, security, robustness, safety and evaluation
title: Traceability, reproducibility and observability
canonical_definition: Material outputs and actions can be reconstructed from evidence, data, component versions, prompts, tools, validations and human decisions with sufficient operational telemetry.

conditions: All systems producing material outputs or actions; depth increases with consequence and audit need.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are required trace events, identifiers, lineage, retention and reconstruction outcomes defined?
Are run manifests, evidence links, component versions, tool logs and governance events captured with integrity controls?
Can representative outputs, failures and decisions be reconstructed and compared across versions and time?

capability_indicators: Model, prompt and tool versions recorded

conditions: Refer a material failure of traceability, reproducibility and observability to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 1.4 (PDF p. 27), MEASURE 2.1 (PDF p. 34), MEASURE 3.1 (PDF p. 35)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on documenting risk processes and evaluation detail, and assigning risk-tracking records. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make traceability, reproducibility and observability verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: D4 evaluates traceability, reproducibility and observability using evidence from intent through operation. AP-D4 independently assesses evidence of opaque and non-reproducible execution.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies a trace contract defining run IDs, version and input lineage, claim links, material events and retention bounds. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates integrity-protected run manifests with effective versions, evidence references, authorization decisions and privacy-bounded logging. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides reconstruction of a representative success, fault and consequential decision from stored records with explicit reconstruction limits. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in traceability, reproducibility and observability, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide a trace contract defining run IDs, version and input lineage, claim links, material events and retention bounds. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate integrity-protected run manifests with effective versions, evidence references, authorization decisions and privacy-bounded logging. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide reconstruction of a representative success, fault and consequential decision from stored records with explicit reconstruction limits. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how traceability, reproducibility and observability works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with a trace contract defining run IDs, version and input lineage, claim links, material events and retention bounds. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use reconstruction of a representative success, fault and consequential decision from stored records with explicit reconstruction limits to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: A privacy-preserving trace can use references and hashes where authorized reviewers can verify the necessary underlying evidence.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-D4 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in traceability, reproducibility and observability
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in traceability, reproducibility and observability
Evidence remains insufficient for traceability, reproducibility and observability in the assessed scope
